d: Hello friends, it is with a heavy heart that I feel finally ready to open up and speak about what's really been going on in my family's life the last 2.5 years. I will let you watch the video for yourself to hear everything from my perspective. I have never shared anything so personal or painful before. I decided to do so now, to bridge a deep gap that I have felt for many years now, between what my life has been in the real world and what my life is on here.
